couplets.en: I can no longer offer love my devotion.

lines: Jis dil pe naaz tha mujhe, woh dil nahin raha
couplets.en: The heart I once took pride in is gone.
I can no longer offer love my devotion.

lines: Wa kar diye hain shauq ne band-e-naqab-e-husn
couplets.en: Longing has undone the ties of beauty's veil.

lines: Ghair az nigah ab koi haail nahin raha
couplets.en: Now only the gaze itself stands in the way.
I can no longer offer love my devotion.

lines: Bedad-e-ishq se nahin darta magar Asad
couplets.en: Love's cruelty does not frighten me, Asad, though there is this.

lines: Jis dil pe naaz tha mujhe, woh dil nahin raha
couplets.en: The heart I once took pride in is gone.
I can no longer offer love my devotion.
